text:
Sam Patel: kicking off Kintara Health onboarding thread — quick sync on stakeholders, success criteria, and timeline. We need owners and any immediate blockers. Who can own enablement and success metrics?

Maria Gonzales: I can own success criteria + enablement. Ballpark metrics to agree on: 1) API integration working with no auth errors; 2) p95 latency < 400ms under small pilot; 3) initial cost target (first 1k queries) — we can set an estimate after seeing prompt mix. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Lee Chen: I’ll be tech owner for integration. Need SSO metadata and network details (VPC peering / IP allowlist). @Devon can you confirm SAML metadata ETA?

Devon Brooks: SAML metadata will be ready Tue 2025-03-28. Customer needs to confirm IdP cert. Also need IP allowlist for dev gateway. Example snippet for their ops team: 

```
env: dev
role: se
grant: customer.kintara@redwood
```

Ana Rivera: PM from Kintara chiming in (cc: Steve, CTO). Primary stakeholders on their side: Steve (CTO), Priya (Lead ML Eng), Nora (Security). They want go-live ~45 days. Proposed milestone plan: week1 integration, week3 UAT, week5 load testing, week7 go-live.

Sam Patel: 45 days is aggressive but doable if we parallelize. Proposed owners:
- Success & enablement: Maria
- Tech integration + SSO: Lee & Devon
- Monitoring + alerting + SLAs: Sam
- Training materials + runbooks: Maria + Ana

Maria Gonzales: I’ll draft an enablement plan by EOD Monday. I’ll need sample queries / eval prompts from Priya to build training & QA checks.

Lee Chen: For infra, request service account details and support windows. @OnboardBot can you create the shared workspace and add Kintara stakeholders + our owners?

OnboardBot: Calendar invite created: "Kintara Onboarding Handoff" Tue 2025-03-28 16:00 PT. Shared doc: https://redwood.docs/s/kit-kintara-onboard — workspace created and members invited.

Devon Brooks: High-level risks to call out: SSO cert delay, security sign-off on data ingress, and Dedicated pool quota. Recommend we enable a canary route and fallback to hosted model for first 48h of traffic.

Sam Patel: Adding renewal/health signals: target 10k queries/mo by month 3. If adoption <30% of target, flag for renewal outreach. Maria will own dashboard alerts.

Ana Rivera: I’ll coordinate stakeholder invites and collect Priya’s prompt set by Friday. Also need legal for DPA — @Sam can you escalate?

Sam Patel: Escalating to legal now and adding to legal queue. Quick 14-day checklist I’ll track: 
- Day 0: SSO exchange, env access granted
- Day 1-7: API integration + smoke tests
- Day 8-21: UAT + evaluation comparisons
- Day 22-35: Load test + cost tuning
- Day 36-45: Go/no-go & cutover plan

Maria Gonzales: I’ve blocked training slots Wednesdays 11am PT for the next 4 weeks; will send invites once prompts arrive.

Lee Chen: Opening firewall / network request. Infra runbook posted here: https://redwood.run/infra/kintara — will update with IPs once we get allowlist.

Ana Rivera: thanks — next sync on Tue after the handoff meeting. Any immediate blockers?

Priya (Kintara): Priya here — we’ll share sample prompts by Thursday and IdP cert by Monday. Thanks everyone!

Sam Patel: Great — noted. @everyone :thumbsup: Closing this thread for now; will pick up in the calendar invite.
